title: THE RASCAHOUSE
description: Writing, observations, and things worth returning to.
intro: A small corner of the internet for writing, passing observations, and things worth returning to. An archive, always in the making.
aboutTitle: A home for words, images, and unfinished questions.
aboutText: THE RASCAHOUSE gathers longer pieces and smaller notes in one place. Some things need an essay. Others need only a few lines. This is a space for both, growing one entry at a time.
